### API Completion v
- To avoid logging into GitHub, I will post the completion prompts and update information here.

|Trigger|-|Complete|
|-|-|-|
|p+prefab ID|-|Prefab ID completion, you can search for translation names|
|tag+tagname|-|Tag completion, welcome to contribute comments, the community depends on everyone|
|g+methodname|-|Query for uncommon global methods (common ones can be typed directly, uncommon ones will be put into g+)|
|com+componentname|-|Query for uncommon components|
|normal trigger method+i|-|Inspire Mode: Provides some code blocks|
|contri+components|-|Become a contributor!(comment template)|
|LAN+param|-|Method parameter comment---$param: (param) <type> [desc] {others}|
|LAN+return|-|Method return comment---$return: <type> [desc]|
|LANcomponent|-|Insert empty component code block|
|LANstring|-|Insert Prefab Translation Block|
|upper/lower|-|select string to upper/lower|
